targets.rawSql: SELECT measured_at AS time, temperature_c AS value, device_id || ' / measured' AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY measured_at

SELECT measured_at AS time, setpoint_c AS value, device_id || ' / setpoint' AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND setpoint_c IS NOT NULL ORDER BY measured_at
SELECT measured_at AS time, heater_voltage AS value, device_id AS metric FROM simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) ORDER BY measured_at
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(measured_at)))::double precision AS age_seconds FROM simulation_measurements WHERE device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Mean absolute error
panels.description: Sample mean of |setpoint - raw temperature| over the selected period. Measurements without a setpoint are excluded. This is not the filtered control error.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(abs(setpoint_c - temperature_c)) AS "Absolute error" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND setpoint_c IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Min. / max. temperature
panels.description: Lowest and highest raw temperature for the selected period and devices.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(temperature_c) AS "Minimum", max(temperature_c) AS "Maximum" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Mean heater input
panels.description: Sample mean over the selected period. Input voltage, not electrical power or energy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(heater_voltage) AS "Heater input" FROM public.simulation_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(measured_at) AND device_id IN (${device:sqlstring})

panels.title: Change Pi setpoint
panels.description: Controls airheater-sim-1. Enter the control key for each command; it is not stored in the dashboard JSON. Confirmation comes from the Pi. The chart updates with the next telemetry message.

list.name: device
list.label: Source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_id FROM simulation_measurements ORDER BY device_id
